claim_boundary: external supervised full-state readout availability only; not Demian action selection, internal storage, channel ownership, recovery, adaptation, learning, or architecture benefit
history_design: one balanced length-32 distractor corpus per seed/cue; delay states use exact prefixes
fit: one readout per seed on all train histories/delays; frozen thereafter
decision_rule: at each delay in >=5/6 seeds, heldout Demian readout accuracy >=.50 and exceeds both latest and no-storage by >=.15; otherwise exact task unestablished with no retuning
